text:
Lena: Quick heads-up for managers: uploaded the "Review Coverage Rota" + updated manager packet. Need ACKs by Tue 11/09 EOD so we can publish the final calendar.
Omar: where's the rota? can you paste path?
Lena: Drive: /drive/PeopleOps/2026_cycle/Manager_Packet_Coverage.pdf and Coverage_Rota_2026.xlsx (same folder).
Priya: TL;DR on the rota? how does backup coverage work if a manager is travelling?
Lena: short: each manager has a paired backup reviewer for the review window. If primary is unavailable >48h, backup becomes responsible reviewer and adds a small note prefixed with "Coverage note:" listing sources used. Backups are listed in the rota; People Ops will assign if no backup present.
Gus: can we standardize the "Coverage note" text? calibration chairs like consistency.
Lena: yes use this exact line: "Coverage note: Primary manager unavailable; backup compiled review from Evidence links and peer notes dated MM/DD-MM/DD. Recommended band: X. Sources: <links>." Copy verbatim.
Omar: what about last-minute reviewer swaps? happens when a manager gets pulled into incident response.
Lena: policy: swaps allowed but must be emailed to people-ops@redwood with subject "Reviewer Swap: <IC name>" and include original and new reviewer names, reason, and expected completion by date. People Ops approves and updates rota.
Priya: any changes to evidence requirements this cycle? want to prep teams.
Lena: evidence expectations updated: 2-5 objective artifacts (PRs, tickets, customer quotes) each with a one-line evidence summary and date. Evidence should be in the Evidence_Sheet.csv template. Promotions must use Promotions_Form_SEPARATE.docx; do NOT put promo rationale in the regular review notes.
Gus: calibration dry run? last time chairs wanted a rehearsal.
Lena: doing a 60-min calibration dry run for chairs + facilitation leads on 11/15 09:00 PT. Attendance required for calibration chairs; recording available. Also running 15-min manager micro-huddles (drop-in) 11/10-11/12 for quick evidence QA.
HR-bot: Reminder: Review_Template_Coverage.docx is required for regular ICs; ShortReview_Template for interns. Auto-reminders will run at 7 days, 72h, 24h, and 6h before close.
Omar: data export timing and redaction rules? we have to coordinate with Comp Ops.
Lena: export snapshot for calibration chairs on 11/29 08:00 PT. Export includes reviewer notes, evidence links, and recommended band. Redacted fields: salary, bank/account details, personal contact info, and any free-text mentioning protected classes or medical details. Attachments flagged "customer_pii" must be sanitized before upload.
Priya: can managers preview the export to catch accidental sensitive text?
Lena: yes preview window on 11/28. Submit preview requests to people-ops@redwood by 11/25. We'll run one preview per team and return a redaction log.
Gus: late submission policy? some teams always run late.
Lena: forms lock at 11/29 17:00 PT. Late submissions require Late_Request.docx and People Ops approval. If approved before calibration starts, reviews are included; otherwise they roll to the next calibration window. We offer a 48h documented grace for production incidents only.
Omar: dispute/appeal timeline?
Lena: post-calibration dispute window is 5 business days. Use Dispute_Form.docx. People Ops mediates; final decision by Head of People. Procedural disputes get expedited.
Priya: any new mandatory training this year?
Lena: new: 30-min "Calibration Norms" session on 11/22 11:00 PT for all managers attending calibration. Chairs have an extra facilitation block on 11/21 10:00-11:00.
HR-bot: Note: misuse of Coverage notes or Confidential flags to hide required info will trigger follow-up by People Ops. :warning:
Gus: can people-ops publish a nightly missing-items digest grouped by team? makes chasing simpler.
Lena: yes we'll post a nightly digest at 09:00 PT starting 11/20 and DM managers for missing forms, missing Evidence_Sheet rows, or missing attachments.
Omar: ACK I'll block time with my managers and review the rota.
Priya: ACK thanks for the clarity.
Gus: ACK
